sentence: Tracks what each person paid for a shared event, splits the total evenly across the chat, and shows the fewest payments that settle everyone up, with a way to mark each payment sent.
use_when: A group shared costs for a meal or party and needs to know who owes whom
Someone asks to split a bill evenly among everyone in the chat
People want to add what they paid and see the fewest payments to settle up
The group wants to mark payments as sent and see when all are settled
dont_use_when: The split should be uneven, by percentage, or by what each person ordered
The group needs a running tally of debts over weeks or months across many events
Someone wants to actually send money or link a payment app
